title: Meadow Awakening
summary: The expedition finds its footing and clears the meadow's edge.

title: Icefield Reckoning
summary: With the meadow open, the expedition pushes north onto the Stoneguard's frozen shelf.

title: Embervale Outskirts
summary: Embervale's militia holds its walls, and the wilds aren't the only thing pressing on them.

title: Norhollow Outskirts
summary: Norhollow holds its palisade line by the tally, and the mail keeps arriving already read.

title: The War Comes Home
summary: War is declared, the roads fill with people who left everything behind, and the crossroads at Millcross has to hold them.

title: The Ledger Game
summary: Wear a name Gildmark has never priced, buy a clerk's confession, and get the proof out the harbor gate before the Council notices what's missing.

title: The Truth Arrives Late
summary: Free the Bell-Keeper's daughter, watch the truth go out and get burned anyway, and bury the one who held the crossroads until it did.

title: The Undertow
summary: Stop the relic sale at the harbor, drag the Broker's own hand into the light, and carry the first small crossing to Rooktide — no treaty, only what's left standing once the towns stop needing an enemy to explain themselves.

title: Small Mercies
summary: While the war fills every ledger, four small kindnesses get done anyway — a night's sleep, a shared meal, a letter carried, a medal left unsold.

title: Embers That Remain
summary: A deserter hated as a traitor, a stall rebuilt plank by plank, a letter that beat the worst news to the door — what's left standing in a town that's spent four seasons at war.
